weapons.text: Missile weapons, daggers, swords, short swords, polearms, spears and staves

features.name: Acrobat skills
features.summary: Climb sheer surfaces, falling, hide in shadows, move silently, tightrope walking. See the level table.

features.name: Evasion
features.summary: Tumbling away from melee cancels the attacker's usual +2 to hit.

features.name: Jumping
features.summary: With a 20' run-up, clears a 10' pit (20' with a pole). With a pole, vaults a 10' wall or onto a 10' ledge.

features.name: Tumbling attack
features.summary: A melee attack while falling or jumping does double damage, with +4 to hit against an unaware target.

features.name: Encumbrance
features.summary: Can't evade, fall, jump or tightrope walk if encumbrance cuts movement below 90'.

features.name: Training school
features.summary: May found a training school, attracting 2d6 1st level apprentices.

features.name: Assassin skills
features.summary: Assassination, climb sheer surfaces, hear noise, hide in shadows, move silently. See the level table.

features.name: Assassination
features.summary: +4 to hit an unaware humanoid from behind. On a hit the victim saves versus death, with the table's penalty, or dies. Works on humans, demihumans and humanoids up to 4+1 HD.

features.name: Disguise
features.summary: Each person met has a 2% chance a day to see through a disguise, +2% for each change of class, race or sex.

features.name: Poison
features.summary: Victims of the assassin's poisons save at −2.

features.name: Hirelings
features.summary: No hirelings at 1st–3rd level. From 4th, may hire lower-level assassins; from 8th, thieves; from 12th, anyone.

features.name: Guild
features.summary: May take over an assassins' or thieves' guild by killing its master, keeping a guild of 7d4 members.

features.name: Barbarian skills
features.summary: In the wilderness: climb natural surfaces, hide in undergrowth, move silently. See the level table.

features.name: Illiteracy
features.summary: Can't read or write at 1st level, whatever their INT.

features.name: Cure poison
features.summary: In the wilderness, brews an antidote in a turn per patient. Each gets a second save against natural poison.

features.name: Fear of magic
features.summary: Won't knowingly use magic items or be affected by spells, except divine magic of their tribe's religion.

features.name: Foraging and hunting
features.summary: A party with one forages successfully on 2-in-6 and finds prey on 5-in-6 when hunting.

features.name: Agile fighting
features.summary: +1 AC at 4th level, +2 at 6th, +3 at 8th, +4 at 10th.

features.name: Strike invulnerable monsters
features.summary: Can hit monsters that only magic can harm.

features.name: Horde
features.summary: May raise a horde of 250 1st level fighters per level above 7th for one purpose. It gathers in a week and stays a week per level.

weapons.text: Missile weapons and one-handed melee weapons

features.name: Divine magic
features.summary: Prays for druid spells from 2nd level, and must stay in their deity's favour. Can use druids' magic items.

features.name: Anti-charm
features.summary: While the bard plays and sings, allies within 30' are immune to song magic and fairy or sylvan charms. Allies already affected save again at +4.

features.name: Enchantment
features.summary: Out of combat, music fascinates up to 2 HD of creatures per level within 30' (save versus spells): persons, animals from 4th level, monsters from 7th. A full turn's performance may charm them for a turn per level (save at +2).

features.name: Languages
features.summary: Learns an extra language at 4th level and every even level after. May learn Druidic.

features.name: Lore
features.summary: 2-in-6 to know lore of monsters, magic items or legendary heroes, including what a magic item does.

features.name: Manor
features.summary: May establish a manor, attracting 2d6 1st level apprentice bards.

features.name: Divine magic
features.summary: Prays for spells from 2nd level. Must carry a holy symbol and stay in their deity's favour.

features.name: Turn undead
features.summary: Roll 2d6 against the turning table to make undead flee or destroy them. On success, 2d6 HD of undead are affected (at least one monster).

features.name: Create magic items
features.summary: Can make magic items through magical research.

features.name: Stronghold
features.summary: May build a stronghold (half cost if in favour), attracting 5d6×10 devoted 1st–2nd level fighters.

turnUndead.note: Number = 2d6 roll needed; T = turned; D = destroyed; null = cannot turn. 2* = 2 HD with a special ability.
turnUndead.levelsAbove: Use the last row for level 11 and above.

features.name: Divine magic
features.summary: Prays for cleric spells, only light (darkness) at 1st level. From 3rd level may also pray for web. Must carry a holy symbol and stay in their deity's favour.

features.name: Detect secret doors
features.summary: 2-in-6 to find secret doors when searching.

features.name: Immunity to ghoul paralysis
features.summary: Unaffected by ghoul paralysis.

features.name: Infravision
features.summary: Sees heat in the dark to 90'.

features.name: Light sensitivity
features.summary: −2 to attack rolls and −1 AC in bright light.

features.name: Listening at doors
features.summary: 2-in-6 to hear noises.

features.name: Spider affinity
features.summary: Speaks the secret language of spiders; +1 to reaction rolls with spiders.

features.name: Create magic items
features.summary: Can make magic items through magical research.

features.name: Stronghold
features.summary: May build an underground stronghold or temple (half cost if in favour), attracting 5d6×10 devoted 1st–2nd level drow.

weapons.text: Clubs, daggers, slings, spears and staves only

features.name: Divine magic
features.summary: Prays to nature for spells. Must carry a sprig of mistletoe they harvested themselves as a holy symbol, and stay in their deity's favour. Can't use magical books or tomes.

features.name: No metal armour
features.summary: Can't wear metal armour or carry a metal shield. Wooden shields cost the same as a normal shield.

features.name: Energy resistance
features.summary: +2 to saves against fire and electricity.

features.name: Identification
features.summary: Knows every plant and animal on sight, and can tell whether water is pure.

features.name: Languages
features.summary: Speaks the druids' secret tongue. Learns one language of the Sylvan forests' creatures at each level after 2nd.

features.name: Path-finding
features.summary: A party with a druid gets lost in woodland only on 1-in-6.

features.name: Pass without trace
features.summary: Leaves no tracks in natural surroundings, and moves through overgrowth at normal speed.

features.name: Charm immunity
features.summary: Immune to the charms of fairies and Sylvan creatures.

features.name: Shape change
features.summary: Once a day each, becomes a reptile, a bird or a mammal, up to about twice their size. Regains 1d4 hit points per level on changing; gear merges into the animal form.

features.name: Create magic items
features.summary: Can make magic items through magical research.

features.name: Druid hierarchy
features.summary: Only nine druids may be 12th level, three 13th, and one 14th (the arch-druid). To rise, a druid must defeat one of that level in a challenge both agree to.

features.name: Stronghold
features.summary: May build a stronghold set into a natural place.

features.name: Detect construction tricks
features.summary: 2-in-6 to notice new construction, sliding walls or sloping passages when searching.

features.name: Detect room traps
features.summary: 2-in-6 to find non-magical room traps when searching.

features.summary: Sees heat in the dark to 90'.

features.name: Light sensitivity
features.summary: −2 to attack rolls and −1 AC in bright light.

features.summary: 2-in-6 to hear noises.

features.name: Mental powers
features.summary: Once a day per level, after a round's concentration: enlarge (double melee damage, 1d4 rounds), invisibility (1 HD of onlookers per level, one turn), shrink to 6" (a turn per level), or heat (1d4 damage a round, a round per level).

features.name: Stealth

features.summary: 2-in-6 to hear noises.

features.name: Speak with burrowing mammals
features.summary: Speaks the secret language of burrowing mammals.

features.name: Stronghold

features.summary: 90% to hide in woods or undergrowth. 2-in-6 in dungeons, needing cover and staying still and silent.

features.name: Initiative bonus
features.summary: +1 to individual initiative (optional rule).

features.name: Listening at doors
features.summary: 2-in-6 to hear noises.

features.name: Missile attack bonus
features.summary: +1 to attack rolls with missile weapons.

features.name: Stronghold

features.name: Half-orc skills
features.summary: Hide in shadows, move silently, pick pockets. See the level table.

features.name: Retainers
features.summary: Retainers who aren't half-orcs have −1 loyalty.

features.name: Bandit stronghold
features.summary: May build a bandit stronghold, attracting 2d6 1st level fighters, thieves or half-orcs.

features.summary: Casts illusionist spells from a spell book. Can use arcane scrolls and items such as wands, but not items that do direct damage.

features.name: Stronghold
features.summary: May build a tower, attracting 1d6 apprentices of levels 1–3.

features.name: Knighthood
features.summary: A squire at 1st–2nd level. Knighted at 3rd, with the right to a coat of arms.

features.name: Chivalric code
features.summary: Earns no XP for deeds against the code. Dishonour can cost the knighthood, leaving a fighter. Must share their liege's alignment.

features.name: Prowess of arms
features.summary: Scorns missile weapons and non-metal armour, wears the most impressive armour available, and seeks out the worthiest foe.

features.name: Horsemanship
features.summary: Can judge a steed's hit points. From 5th level, once a day urges a steed 30' faster for up to 6 turns.

features.name: Mounted combat
features.summary: +1 to attack rolls when mounted.

features.name: Strength of will
features.summary: +4 to saves against charms, holds and mind control, +2 against illusions, and a save against sleep. Immune to magical fear; from 3rd level, allies within 10' get +2 to save against fear, and hirelings +2 to loyalty and morale.

features.name: Hospitality
features.summary: Can expect hospitality from nobles and knights of the same alignment or allegiance, and must return it.

features.name: Stronghold
features.summary: May build a castle with their liege's permission. From 9th level, may be made a baron.

features.name: Flying mounts
features.summary: Can train flying monsters of HD up to their level as mounts, in a month (referee's call).

features.summary: Casts spells from a spell book. Can use arcane scrolls and items such as wands.

features.summary: Can make magic items through magical research.

features.summary: May build a tower, attracting 1d6 apprentices of levels 1–3.

features.name: Divine magic
features.summary: Prays for cleric spells from 9th level. Must carry a holy symbol and stay in their deity's favour.

features.name: Holy order
features.summary: Changing alignment, for any reason, loses every class ability and leaves a fighter of the same level.

features.name: Holy resistance
features.summary: Immune to disease.

features.name: Laying on hands
features.summary: Once a day, heals 2 hit points per level by touch. From 5th level, also cures disease once a week.

features.name: Vow of humility
features.summary: Keeps only one magic armour, one magic shield and one magic melee weapon. Gives 10% of income to a Lawful church.

features.name: Turn undead
features.summary: Roll 2d6 against the paladin's turning table to make undead flee or destroy them. On success, 2d6 HD of undead are affected (at least one monster).

features.name: Warhorse
features.summary: Can summon a holy warhorse (AC 5 [14], 5+5 HD, 180'). If it dies, no other comes for 10 years.

features.name: Stronghold
features.summary: May build a castle with their order's permission and become a baron.

features.name: Protector
features.summary: Becoming Chaotic loses every class ability and leaves a fighter of the same level.

features.name: Awareness
features.summary: Surprised only on a 1.

features.name: Foraging and hunting
features.summary: A party with one forages successfully on 2-in-6 and finds prey on 5-in-6 when hunting.

features.name: Limited possessions
features.summary: Keeps only what they and their mount can carry, and gives the rest to worthy causes.

features.name: Pursuit
features.summary: When their party gives chase in the wilderness, the quarry's chance to evade drops by 10%.

features.name: Surprise attack
features.summary: 3-in-6 to sneak up on a target unnoticed in the wilderness.

features.name: Tracking
features.summary: Identifies and follows tracks. See the level table; the ground, rain and age change the chance.

features.name: Followers
features.summary: 2d12 followers join, chosen by the referee. They aren't replaced if they die.

features.name: Blend into stone
features.summary: Unnoticed among stone while silent and still: 4-in-6 in gloom, 2-in-6 in good light.

features.name: Defensive bonus
features.summary: +2 AC against attackers larger than human-sized.

features.name: Detect construction tricks
features.summary: 2-in-6 to notice new construction, sliding walls or sloping passages when searching.

features.name: Illusion resistance
features.summary: +2 to saves against illusions.

features.name: Infravision
features.summary: Sees heat in the dark to 90'.

features.name: Light sensitivity
features.summary: −2 to attack rolls and −1 AC in bright light.

features.name: Using magic items
features.summary: Can use any magic item (but not scrolls) that summons or controls earth elementals.

features.name: Speak with earth elementals
features.summary: Speaks the language of earth elementals.

features.name: Stone murmurs
features.summary: After a turn listening to stone, 2-in-6 to learn of secret doors (10'), gems, metal or creatures (30'), or water or open spaces (60').

features.name: Stronghold
features.summary: May build an underground stronghold guarded by 1d3 friendly 16 HD earth elementals. Hires only svirfneblin soldiers.

features.name: Back-stab
features.summary: +4 to hit and double damage against an unaware target from behind.

features.name: Thief skills
features.summary: Climb, find/remove treasure traps, hear noise, hide in shadows, move silently, open locks, pick pockets. See the level table.

features.name: Read languages
features.summary: 80% to read any non-magical text. One try per text per level.

features.name: Scroll use
features.summary: Can cast arcane spells from scrolls, with a 10% chance of a mishap.

features.name: Hideout
features.summary: May build a hideout, attracting 2d6 1st level apprentice thieves.
